instruction: Candid documentary photograph, full-length shot. On a sunny city sidewalk, the smiling woman in the white halter dress (R1) and the person in the denim jacket and khaki shorts (R2) walk hand-in-hand. On the left, the woman (R1) holds her dress hem and looks happily at her partner. On the right, the person (R2) holds a colorful rainbow flag in their left hand while walking forward. They hold hands in the center, sharing a warm, smiling gaze as they walk. The scene is bathed in soft, warm natural daylight, enhancing the joyful mood.
